original_evidence.text: | QMPlay2 | github.com/zaps166/QMPlay2 | Qt/C++ | Y | Windows builds only (`UPDATER` macro, `if(WIN32)` in src/gui/CMakeLists.txt, gated by CMake option `USE_UPDATES` default ON): auto chk + auto dl on startup if "AutoUpdates" setting enabled; auto inst requires one user click ("Apply update" button) which then silently launches the downloaded installer with `--Auto`. Non-Windows builds: notify-only (no UPDATER macro compiled in), no download. | Y (Windows only) | HTTPS to raw.githubusercontent.com for the manifest and for the installer download (`net.start(url)` via app's NetworkAccess wrapper; no explicit SSL-bypass code found anywhere in repo) | N (plain INI-style text file on GitHub raw, not cryptographically signed) | payload check is only a magic-byte sniff of the first chunk (`arr.startsWith("MZ")`, i.e. confirms it's a Windows PE file) — NOT a hash or signature check of the full downloaded installer | n/a (no signing key used; relies on HTTPS+GitHub hosting only) | src/gui/Updater.cpp:110 (`net.start("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zaps166/QMPlay2OnlineContents/master/Updater")`), :150-184 (parses per-OS version/URL from manifest, opens `updateFile` and calls `getFile(FileURL...)`), :219-226 (`writeToFile`: `err = !arr.startsWith("MZ")` on first chunk — only magic-byte check, no hash/signature), :254-259 (`applyUpdate()` calls `QMPlay2GUI.runUpdate(updateFile.fileName())`), src/gui/Main.cpp:132-137 (`runUpdate`: `ShellExecuteW(nullptr, L"open", UpdateFile, L"--Auto", ...)` — executes downloaded .exe), src/gui/MainWidget.cpp:558-560 (auto-trigger: `if (settings.getBool("AutoUpdates")) updater.downloadUpdate();`), src/gui/CMakeLists.txt:118-123 (`if(WIN32) if(USE_UPDATES) add_definitions(-DUPDATER)`), CMakeLists.txt:101 (`option(USE_UPDATES "Build with software updates" ON)`).
